author: Esmay Rosalyne
description:
As a serial series starter, I always love prequel novellas as a low-commitment way to get a little taste test of a new world, but Noah Isaacs surprised me by delivering a whole damn meal instead in Heretic. And honestly, it might not be the easiest to digest at times, but I still ate it […]

title: REVIEW: Heretic by Noah Isaacs
